senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु)
1 Desirous to destroy or lose.
2 Wishing to scorch, fry, parch.
m. (-क्षुः)
Fire.
E.
भ्रस्ज to break, to fry, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing to fry or scorch.
m. (-षुः)
Fire.
E.
भ्रस्ज to fry, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. subst. (-त्सः-त्सा-त्सं)
1 Disgust, abhorrence.
adj.
Detesting, loathing, changed or averted in mind.
2 Cruel, mischievous.
3 Compassionate.
4 Wicked.
5 Envious.
E.
बध to bind, to hate, &c. aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing or purposing to hit or pierce.
E.
वि before भिद to break, desid. v., उ aff.

mfn. (-भ्रन्-भ्रती-भ्रत्)
Having, possessing.
E.
वि before भृ to support, शतृ aff.
